verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a dedicated `logseq://` URI protocol for external apps to invoke actions (including quick capture from command line/bookmarklet), plus a local HTTP APIs server enabling external programmatic access to the graph with authorization — both directly support driving the app from outside scripts/workflows. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming real-world scripting use of the URI scheme or HTTP API, and no OpenAPI/spec discoverability (probe found 404s for API spec endpoints).
